## Admission

Members: FREE  
Adults: $16.00  
Seniors (ages 65+): $12.00  
Groups: $10.00  
High School Students (under 18): FREE  
Children (under 15): FREE  

[Buy Tickets](https://experience.bocamuseum.org/events/8dd7f6ef-dc6c-663b-01e2-4f1fc2fd1c0d)  

Body

## Parking

- Metered street parking is available in Mizner Park.
- Free parking is available in each of the four parking garages. The closest garage is A, located on the northwest corner of Mizner Park, just south of the Museum.
- Handicapped parking is available at no charge with valid handicapped placard in specially designated spaces located along the plaza and parking garages within Mizner Park.

## Accessibility

Everyone is welcome. We offer a variety of support services to make the Boca Raton Museum of Art accessible to all to assist with your visit.

- ADA accessible entrance
- Elevator between floors
- Handicap parking
- Wheelchair accessible bathrooms
- Complimentary wheelchairs (first-come, first-served)
- Sensory kits and maps

For addition accessibility information please refer to:

[Accessibility Info ›](/visit/accessibility)

## The Art Experience

The Museum's mission is to enhance the appreciation and understanding of the visual arts through the presentation of high quality, diverse exhibitions and the acquisition and maintenance of a permanent collection.

For a full list of on-view now, upcoming and past exhibitions and the permanent collection, please refer to:

[Art Experience ›](/art-experience)

## Bloomberg Connects Digital Guide

Explore the Museum with our digital guide on Bloomberg Connects, the free arts and culture app. Our guide takes you behind the scenes at the Boca Raton Museum of Art with exclusive multimedia perspectives from artists, curators, and more.

[Bloomberg Connects ›](/node/2860)

## Cultural Events

Whether you enjoy lectures, demonstrations, films, children's activities or participate in our community events, there are always opportunities to gain more insight into our exhibitions and the artists’ process.

For a full list of upcoming Cultural Events, please refer to:

[Cultural Events ›](/visit/cultural-events)

## Guided & School Tours

Docent-led Guided Tours are available to adult groups at a discounted price. School tours are free of charge at specified times. Please find additional information and request forms in the links below.

[Guided Adult Tours ›](/visit/guided-tours)

[School Tours ›](/art-education/school-tours)

## Museum Store

At our boutique museum store, you will find uncommon objects, contemporary design for your home, toys for kids, handcrafted artisan gifts, and jewelry for him and her.

[Museum Store ›](/visit/museum-store)

## Visitor Policies and Gallery Guidelines

For the enjoyment as well as protection of Museum staff, members and guests, Visitor Policies are in place for reference and adherence.

[Visitor Policies ›](/visit/visitor-policies)

## NARM Association

NARM card holders receive free/member admission during regular hours and 10% discount in the Museum Store. Other restrictions may be applied by individual institutions. At our Museum, NARM privileges may be restricted for concerts/lectures/special exhibitions and ticketed events.

For additional information and participating institutions please refer to:

[NARM Association](https://narmassociation.org/)

## Museums for All

The Boca Raton Museum of Art is proud to participate in Museums for All by providing free admission to individuals receiving food assistance by showing their Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Plan (SNAP) Electronic Benefit Transfer (EBT) card at entry. Museums for All is a national program that encourages people of all backgrounds to visit museums regularly.
For additional information and participating institutions please refer to:

[Museums for All](https://museums4all.org/participating-museums-3/)
